name: Natsuzora Asterism
source:
[i]I wanted to feel yet more closely,
the shine of those stars that seem within arm's reach.[/i]

Beneath this sky unfolds an ordinary girls' summer.

An ordinary summer spent by ordinary girls,
who live in an ordinary town and attend an ordinary school,
walking there down the usual road, at the usual pace, surrounded by the usual smiles.

A single, unchanging summer woven together by these girls.

This is the story of their love that you'll surely want to reach for.
translation:
[i]我想更近距离地感受，
那些星星的光芒似乎触手可及。[/i]

在这片天空下，展开了一个普通女孩的夏天。

普通女孩度过的普通夏天，
他们住在一个普通的城镇，上一所普通的学校，
沿着平常的路，以平常的步伐走在那里，周围都是平常的微笑。

由这些女孩编织而成的单一、不变的夏天。

这是他们的爱情故事，你一定会想要了解。
